package pages

type User {
  name: string
  admin: bool
}

external async LoadUser(id: string): User
external async LoadTags(id: string): string[]

@cache(ttl: "5m")
component Badge(user: User, tone: string): html {
<span class="badge {tone}">{user.name}</span>
}

export component Profile(id: string): html {
<section>
{await user = LoadUser(id), tags = LoadTags(id)}
  <Badge user={user} tone="solid" />
  <ul>
  {for tag in tags}
    <li>{tag}</li>
  {/for}
  </ul>
{fallback}
  <p class="pending">loading…</p>
{recover err}
  <p class="failed">{err.code}: {err.message}</p>
{/await}
</section>
}

export component Page(id: string): html {
<main><Profile id={id} /></main>
}

export component Shell(children: html): html {
<div class="shell">{children}</div>
}

export component Silent(id: string): html {
{await user = LoadUser(id)}
  <p>{user.name}</p>
{fallback}
  <p>waiting</p>
{/await}
}
